aero_while_driving.f1_25: 2026 cars: Active Aero Corner/Straight Line Mode on the DRS/S Mode button, toggle, only inside zones, auto-return (official). 2025 cars: DRS, same button. Wing angles: setup only.
aero_while_driving.gt7: No (downforce is a pre-race Car Setting). DRS only on cars that have it, via the Nitro/Overtake control (button unverified).
aero_while_driving.ac: DRS button on DRS cars (PC names; console unverified). No wing adjustment.
aero_while_driving.iracing: Wing Front/Rear Inc/Dec actions exist for some cars (community); DRS on DRS cars.
aero_while_driving.lmu: No (Rear Flap action exists from rF2 vocabulary; no LMU car known to use it).
aero_while_driving.ams2_r3e_rf2_acevo: DRS on cars that have it (AMS2/R3E/rF2 rear flap/AC EVO toggle).

owner_questions.ride_height_while_driving: No in every game researched. Closest: iRacing weight jacker / track bar on some oval cars (not ride height). F1 and GT7 expose ride height read-only in telemetry.
owner_questions.push_to_talk: F1 25 has its own Push to Talk (pad R3) and UDP Action 1-12, the only path by which pitwall sees a wheel button (BUTN). GT7, AC console, ACC console and Forza send no button data, so pitwall PTT there must be on-screen/iPad (or a device attached to the Mac). iRacing has Voice Chat PTT (unassigned).
owner_questions.esp_stability: GT7 ASM: On/Off in Assistance Settings (pre-race or pause menu), not on the MFD, not bindable; telemetry shows only ASM intervening. F1 25: none. Forza: Stability Control assist (menu). LMU/rF2: stability assist (menu). AC EVO: ESC cycle/direct bindings (community). R3E: ESP aid level visible in telemetry. AMS2: Toggle Stability Control binding (community).
owner_questions.abs: F1 25: assist, menu only (telemetry: enabled flag). GT7: Default/Weak/Off in Assistance Settings (pause menu), no telemetry. AC: ABSUP/ABSDN (PC). ACC: MFD Electronics. iRacing: ABSInc/Dec/Toggle (car-dependent). LMU: LMGT3 car ABS +/-; assist for other classes. AC EVO: ABS +/-/direct.
owner_questions.tc: F1 25: assist, menu only (telemetry 0/1/2). GT7: TCS on the MFD while driving (D-pad up/down; GT DD Pro dedicated stick), telemetry shows only TCS intervening. AC: TCUP/TCDN (PC). ACC: TC and TC2 via MFD/bindings. iRacing: TC/TC2 +/- and toggle. LMU: TC, power cut, slip angle +/- via MFD/bindings. AC EVO: TC/TC cut +/-/direct.
